transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what brought you in to see me today?
I’ve been feeling down for a long time. It’s this flat, heavy feeling most days—like even if work is going okay or someone’s being nice to me, I still feel empty and low.
How long have you been feeling this way—has it been going on for a few weeks, or more like months or years?
It’s been more like years—about two years and two months. I think it started around the time that dashboard project put me in the spotlight at work.
During these two years, have there been any stretches—weeks or months—where your mood actually returned to normal, or has it been low pretty much every day the whole time?
No, I can’t really think of a stretch where it felt normal again. It’s been this low, empty feeling most days, even when things around me are going okay.

During these two years, have there been any periods—lasting two weeks or more—when your mood got much worse, along with things like trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, loss of interest in almost everything, or trouble concentrating?
I’m not really sure. I know I’ve felt low most of the time, but I haven’t noticed a clear period where it suddenly got a lot worse for two weeks or more.

Right now, along with feeling low, are you also experiencing several of the following nearly every day: trouble sleeping or sleeping too much, changes in appetite, low energy, trouble concentrating, or feelings of hopelessness?
Yeah, I feel pretty hopeless about the future. I used to make detailed plans for an MBA and my career, but now when I look at them, I just assume I won’t get there no matter how hard I try.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed changes in your sleep—either trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual—nearly every night?
I’m not sure I’ve noticed a real change in my sleep lately.
Over the past two weeks, have you noticed any changes in your appetite or energy levels, or trouble concentrating, nearly every day?

Yeah—my energy’s been really low. By the afternoon I’m so wiped out that even fixing a spreadsheet error or finishing expense paperwork feels like dragging my body and brain through mud. Even getting myself to soccer feels like a huge effort.
Over the past two weeks, have you noticed trouble concentrating or making decisions nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear problem with concentrating or making decisions lately.
